notes: Verified GitHub-source Warcraft II Grunt guide: first five walk frames × five facing angles. One-shot Muse proof of concept; no automatic paid retries. Output high-definition illustrated WarConquer PNG.

jobs.unit_description: Original WarConquer Marches axe infantryman, HUMAN ex-woodsman of the border, large repaired haft of his axe; patched oxblood wool, soot-dark armor, weathered leather straps, dark oak, patinated copper and memory-ribbons. Never resemble a Warcraft orc; preserve our exact WarConquer concept design.
jobs.pose_notes: The source Grunt sprite sheet has 5 columns of facing directions and 5 full rows of walking poses at the top. Read TIME VERTICALLY down each column: rows 1-5 are walk cycle frames, columns 1-5 are five real facing directions. Preserve that exact structure and position mapping in the new WarConquer human axe-fighter, fully replacing the visual character. Anchor feet at the same baseline in every image.
